title: Kulkul Pukul Enam
subject: Pak Wayan, keeper of the banjar's wooden kulkul slit drum, keeps striking six o'clock after the village WhatsApp group replaced him, until children who have never heard it up close ask to try
caption: Balinese fingerstyle acoustic pop, unhurried swaying pulse. Nylon-string guitar fingerpicking a rolling pattern with open strings, airy bamboo suling playing short answering phrases, soft hand drum on the downbeats, light shaker. Open evening-air recording, close nylon guitar, very light room reverb. Male vocal, low-mid register, plain warm tone, clearly sung melody. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 82 BPM, E minor. Gentle, wistful, hopeful mood. No drum kit, no gamelan, no electric guitar, no synths, no autotune, no rap.
lyrics:
[Intro - nylon guitar, suling]

[Verse 1]
Pak Wayan naik ke bale pukul enam
Tangannya pegang pemukul kayu tua
Kulkul sudah lama tak ditunggu
Semua orang punya grup di telepon

[Pre-Chorus]
Pesan masuk sebelum bunyinya sampai
Tapi dia pukul juga, tetap pukul

[Chorus]
Tok tok tok, kulkul di bale
Pukul enam, tak ada yang menyuruh
Biar kampung tahu hari sudah selesai
Biar jalan pulang masih punya suara

[Verse 2]
Sore itu anak-anak berlari ke bale
Kakek, boleh coba sekali saja
Pak Wayan angkat pemukul, ragu sebentar
Lalu tangan kecil ia bimbing pelan

[Pre-Chorus]
Bunyi pertama terlalu keras, mereka tertawa
Burung di beringin ikut terkejut

[Chorus]
Tok tok tok, kulkul di bale
Pukul enam, kini ada yang menemani
Biar kampung tahu hari sudah selesai
Biar tangan tua tak sendirian

[Bridge - guitar alone]
Besok mereka datang lagi, bawa teman
Kopinya dingin, Pak Wayan tak peduli

[Chorus]
Tok tok tok, kulkul di bale
Pukul enam, bergantian sekarang
Biar kampung tahu hari sudah selesai
Biar bunyi ini ada yang meneruskan

[Outro - suling, guitar fades]
